entries.title: Smoothness
entries.excerpt: Be smoother. Be patient. Mark Twain의 Huckleberry Finn 에서 배운 부드러움에 대한 단상.
entries.body: I've read Mark Twain's *Adventures of Huckleberry Finn*. The character Finn decided to pretend to believe what the liars said in the narrow raft. He thought, "happiness at the moment may be more important than the right answer." I also think like that. The thought like this helps me become smoother.

entries.title: Inner value
entries.excerpt: How long can I live? 다른 이의 박수보다 자기 호흡에 귀 기울이는 것에 대해.
entries.quote: People who listen to whether others' applause is false or true cannot laugh. But anyone who listens to their breath can laugh.
entries.body: I like this quote. This sentence helps me focus on myself, not others. For getting to grow, I hope to be a reliable person.

entries.title: Importance of Documentation
entries.excerpt: What is the most important thing in research? Google이 문서화에 집중하는 이유에 대한 짧은 메모.
entries.lead: What is the most important thing in research?
entries.body: I heard the global company 'Google' has focused on documentation about their research. However, many companies in Korea don't concentrate on this work because of only achieving short-term goals. I think documentation gives me many benefits in aspects of career development and self-care. I hope this attitude won't change.
